Ticket:
Password reset policies and staff account lockout issues

Good morning, I am writing because I am a bit confused about how our practice is supposed to handle staff password resets and overall security policies. Yesterday, two of our part-time staff members got locked out of their accounts after trying to log in, and when I went to the admin panel to reset their credentials, I couldn't find where to adjust the lockout duration or complexity requirements. We are on the essentials plan, and I want to make sure we are compliant without making it impossible for everyone to sign in. Could someone please explain where these settings are hidden and how I can update our practice-wide policy?

  "draft": "Hi there,

Thank you for reaching out and letting us know about the difficulties you’re experiencing with password reset policies and account lockout settings. I understand how important it is to have clear and secure procedures for your staff.

I’ve escalated this to a member of our support team who will review your account and the configuration options available on the Essentials plan. They’ll be in touch with you shortly to help clarify where these settings can be found and how to adjust them to meet your practice’s security needs.

If you have any additional details you’d like to share in the meantime, please feel free to reply to this message.

Best regards,
[Your Support Team]"
